notes: Pages opened: 2 of 1-2. Infobox area: none. START: Cliopatria opens in 1111, the infobox says 'Established: c. 1180'; the dossier starts in 1180 and the 1111 shape is limited to 1180-1205. The Polotsk dossier has Koknese leaving Polotsk's direct rule in 1101; neither page opened dates that for Koknese. END: infobox 1208, body 'By 1209', Cliopatria 1209; 1209 kept. SHAPE: Cliopatria's band (10 grid cells) misses the castle the infobox gives as the capital, which the correction repairs with a 15 km disc. The 1205 grant of half the land to Albert of Riga is on the page but the page does not say which half, so it has no ledger event; the Riga dossier should carry the protection relation. The Livonian Brothers of the Sword dossier dates the takeover 1208-1210 in a single gain from principality-of-jersika (confidence 1) that covers Koknese; this dossier dates it 1209 at confidence 3. Gazetteer: 'Koknese' (place, Latvia, Daugava) is not a gazetteer place; the admin-1 'Kokneses' exists.
